title: Concept: Jinja2 template error returned to a client
description: A Jinja2 template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The traceback fragment names the template and the undefined value, which is the binding an attacker would try to influence.
applicability: Deployments that render a Jinja2 template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The traceback fragment names the template and the undefined value, which is the binding an attacker would try to influence.
